title: Hello.
slide_intent: Set a conversational expectation with a greeting readers might hear from a person. Its brevity leaves space for a reader to enter the book.
strategic_value: Slack can make its friendly tone tangible before giving formal instructions. The waving hand and short welcome provide the example.
demonstration: A waving hand sits above a large greeting and a shorter welcome on a pale field. All three align near the lower left.
practical_value: For an opening page, compare the warmth and brevity of this greeting with the information that can wait until the contents page.

content_islands.name: Waving hand
content_islands.spec: Place the small waving-hand emoji above the greeting and leave the upper field open.

content_islands.name: Greeting and welcome
content_islands.spec: Stack the oversized greeting and smaller welcome on one left edge near the bottom of the pale page.
